address: piazza Vieira de Mello 4, Bologna, 40128, Italy
bio: Housed in a futuristic building which extends like a bridge over Via Stalingrado, La Porta Restaurant is a multi-purpose establishment which includes a café (accessible from the garage), a bistro serving simple meals at lunchtime, and an elegant restaurant with wood decor where gourmet cuisine can be enjoyed in the evening. The menu features an array of fish, meat and vegetable options, while service comes courtesy of a mainly female team, all of whom are extremely friendly and welcoming....
